scope: Non-Wikimedia English web evidence for the 53 frozen development sources only
collection: AI-assisted, not a standalone Python web-search client
first_three_queries: Submitted together; the provider returned a shared source list. Selection for these three sources was manual and AI-assisted. Audit files preserve the complete query batch.
remaining_queries: Each source queried separately; up to three independent sources collected concurrently. Primary-domain and English-word heuristics selected up to two URLs from the returned list.
extraction: Opened HTML uses extractive paragraph windows. PDF and unavailable page bodies use explicitly labelled search snippets. Reused URL excerpts remain fixed. Snippets are not validated full-page content.
limits: 25-word excerpts cannot establish full claim coverage. Search queries inherit blind-translation errors. Present references may be irrelevant or wrong; neither presence nor a later same-model self-check establishes fidelity.
pre_freeze_corrections: An unavailable JavaScript URL constructor and a PDF line-format parsing assumption were corrected before the first model run; preliminary false-empty entries are retained in collection_debug. Tracking-URL duplicates were removed before freezing. No C generation preceded these corrections.
timestamps: UTC tool/cache capture times; repeated pages may reuse an earlier opened tool result.
